name: After § 2
title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2024
part_text: 2a. Calls on the Commission to revise, as a matter of priority, its strategic approach on enforcing EU law, so as to enable Parliament to make full use of the potential of the right to petition enshrined in the EU Treaties as well as in the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU; believes that the Commission must ensure transparency and access to documents exchanged between its services and Member States’ authorities in the framework of infringement and EU pilot procedures as well as drastically reducing the time it takes to bring infringement cases before the Court of Justice of the EU; reiterates its call on the Commission to provide legal clarity on the criteria used to take formal action against Member States in cases of violations of EU law and underpinning the Commission’s strategic approach on the enforcement of EU law;
